name: Bachelor Fish Stew
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 tin (400 g / 240 g drained) beans (kidney, soya, black eye, chickpeas, etc.) in brine
1 tin (120 g) mackerel fillets in tomato sauce

steps: Open all the tins. Drain the liquid from the beans.
Add all ingredients into a saucepan.
Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until hot enough to eat (5–10 minutes).

culture.text: Fish stew is a stew with a soup base or ingredient of fish as food.
